name: Mugen Senshi Valis Doppel X
original_name: 夢幻戦士ヴァリス ドッペル・イクス
source:
Yuko is awaken as a soldier of V*lis.
She fights to save the world called vanity, and Vecanti, a monster from the dark world stands in the way.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE046301.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
优子作为瓦利斯的士兵觉醒。
她为拯救名为“虚荣”的世界而战，来自黑暗世界的怪物维坎蒂挡在了路上。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE046301.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
